report:
## Verdict: APPROVE with notes (two minor comment notes, eight checklist items not settled from source)
The PR is ready to merge: no reviewer or checklist item found a defect at or above the Important threshold, and all twelve acceptance criteria were itemized.
Rule applied: rule 6 — findings below the threshold and INCONCLUSIVE checklist items → APPROVE with notes

## Code Review Findings

### 🟡 Suggestion / Minor (2)

<details><summary>2 items</summary>

1. `docs/internal/agent/factory.md` line 83 says the 2.x SDK sends API version `2026-10-21`, which rejects `temperature`. The reviewer could not find that version string in the head view. The same reason appears in `changelog.d/390.changed.md` line 1, `docs/external/configuration.md` line 61 and `TEMPERATURE_REMOVED_MESSAGE` in `src/sqllens/config.py`. The final-pass reviewer reports that the version matches `ANTHROPIC_API_VERSION` in the installed SDK. (raised by 1/5 agents)
2. `pyproject.toml` line 33: the unchanged comment "Thinking/signature stream events must survive Opus tool-use rounds." now sits above the new `anthropic>=2.8,<3` floor. That floor is set by the 2.x API and `output_config`, so the comment no longer gives the reason for it. (raised by 1/5 agents)

</details>

### ℹ️ Informational — Deferred (8)

- VC-1: INCONCLUSIVE (important) — The anthropic 2.x SDK's AsyncAnthropic messages.create and messages.stream accept an `output_config` keyword argument and serialize it into the request body as `output_config`. [src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py:244]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The item has no dependency_sources, and the anthropic SDK source is not in the head view (inventory.json has no site-packages/anthropic/resources/messages entry). The only copy found is in the working-tree .venv, which I may not use. I did read the caller: llm.py:244 sets payload["output_config"] = {"effort": request.effort}. I did not read AsyncMessages.create or AsyncMessages.stream, so I could not confirm that they accept output_config or serialize it into the request body.

  </details>

- VC-2: INCONCLUSIVE (suggestion) — The anthropic 2.x SDK accepts an `httpx2.AsyncClient` passed as `http_client` to AsyncAnthropic (the tests pass an httpx2 client, not an httpx one). [tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py:79]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The item has no dependency_sources, so the anthropic 2.x SDK source (AsyncAnthropic.__init__ and its http_client type check) is not available for this review. I did not read it and I did not search the views for a vendored copy. What the repository shows: tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py:79-80 builds httpx2.AsyncClient(transport=httpx2.MockTransport(handler)) and passes it as http_client to AnthropicLlmService. src/sqllens/agent/integrations/anthropic/llm.py:66-72 forwards extra_client_kwargs unchanged to anthropic.AsyncAnthropic(**client_kwargs). The docstring at llm.py:41 says the SDK rejects a synchronous http_client. The SDK's accepted client type is the missing evidence. A test in the repo that runs this path would show it, but I did not run one.

  </details>

- VC-3: INCONCLUSIVE (suggestion) — httpx2 exposes `Request`, `Response(status, headers=, text=/json=)`, `AsyncClient(transport=)` and `MockTransport(handler)` with httpx-compatible behavior, and `req.content` holds the JSON body bytes. [tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py:70]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The item has no dependency_sources, and httpx2 source is not vendored in the head view (Glob for httpx2*/**/__init__.py found nothing). The repo only pins httpx2==2.16.0 (requirements.txt:50) and uses httpx2.Request/Response/AsyncClient/MockTransport in tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py:70-79 and tests/unit/test_opus_history.py:122-144. How httpx2 behaves cannot be settled from those usages. Not run: reading httpx2 2.16.0 source (exports MockTransport, AsyncClient, Request.content, Response kwargs).

  </details>

- VC-6: INCONCLUSIVE (suggestion) — The stream request body sent by the SDK contains `"stream": true` and the create body does not set stream true, so the handler can distinguish them by `body.get("stream")`. [tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py:71]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The claim depends on how the installed anthropic 2.x SDK builds the body for messages.stream versus messages.create. The item has no dependency_sources field, and the anthropic source is not in the head view (it is not a committed vendor/ directory). I read the test handler at tests/unit/test_llm_sampling_options.py:70-77. It branches on body.get('stream') and returns SSE for a truthy value. The test at line 89 also asserts [False, True] for the two captured bodies. That shows what the test expects, not what the SDK sends. Missing evidence: anthropic/resources/messages/messages.py (AsyncMessages.stream and create), or a run of the test.

  </details>

- VC-11: INCONCLUSIVE (suggestion) — The docs assert the anthropic 2.x SDK sends API version 2026-10-21 which rejects a request carrying temperature. [docs/internal/agent/factory.md:83]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The claim at docs/internal/agent/factory.md:83 (anthropic 2.x SDK sends API version 2026-10-21, which rejects temperature) depends on the installed SDK's default anthropic-version header and on server behaviour. The item has no dependency_sources, and a grep of the head view finds 2026-10-21 and anthropic-version only in this doc line, so the SDK source is not in the views. A copy exists in the working tree at .venv/.../anthropic/_client.py, but I did not read it because working-tree fallback is not allowed. The server-side rejection of temperature cannot be verified from source either. Missing evidence: anthropic 2.8.0 _client.py default headers.

  </details>

- VC-13: INCONCLUSIVE (important) — requirements.txt pins anthropic==2.8.0, and the lock is consistent with anthropic 2.8.0's dependencies (distro removed because 2.x no longer requires it; httpx2 is pulled where needed). [requirements.txt]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  Head requirements.txt:23 pins anthropic==2.8.0; distro==1.9.0 line removed (diff hunk @@ -32,7); head has httpx==0.28.1 (:48) and httpx2==2.16.0 (:50), httpx2-jsfetch (:51). So the repo side of the claim holds. However the claim depends on anthropic 2.8.0's Requires-Dist, and no dependency_sources were supplied and no anthropic-2*/METADATA exists in the views (Glob found none). Cannot confirm that 2.8.0 drops distro or requires httpx2 (versus httpx). Missing evidence: anthropic-2.8.0.dist-info/METADATA.

  </details>

- VC-15: INCONCLUSIVE (suggestion) — The changelog asserts the 2.x SDK and the API version it sends reject a sampling temperature and that no other setting replaces it. [changelog.d/390.changed.md:1]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  The claim in changelog.d/390.changed.md:1 depends on installed anthropic 2.8.x behavior (whether AsyncMessages.create declares temperature and whether the API version it sends rejects it). The item has no dependency_sources, and anthropic source is not in the head view. Searched the repo's .venv anthropic messages.py for 'temperature' and found no matches, but that path is outside the supplied dependency directories and its version is unconfirmed. Other site-packages copies found elsewhere on disk were not read and are unverified as the locked version. Also, an SDK signature lacking a temperature parameter would not by itself show the API rejects it, and the 'no other setting replaces it' part is not settled either. Missing evidence: the locked anthropic 2.8.0 source from dependency_sources, plus the API's behavior.

  </details>

- VC-18: INCONCLUSIVE (critical) — `test_real_sdk_stream_retains_signature_and_tool_input` and `test_real_sdk_create_retains_signature_and_tool_input` in `tests/unit/test_opus_history.py` run the locked 2.x SDK against a mock HTTP transport and pass. Their assertions on `provider_content`, `content`, `finish_reason`, `usage` and tool calls are unchanged. [tests/unit/test_opus_history.py]

  <details><summary>Evidence</summary>

  Criterion 3 counted (criteria.json is a valid list of {criterion,text}). Verified by reading: diff.patch hunks for tests/unit/test_opus_history.py (lines 615-655) change only httpx -> httpx2 (import, handler type hints, AsyncClient/MockTransport/Response). Head file lines 98-154 shows both tests use httpx2.MockTransport with AnthropicLlmService(api_key=..., http_client=client); assertions on provider_content (131, 151), content (148), finish_reason (149), usage (150) and tool_calls (152-154) are untouched context lines in the diff, so 'assertions unchanged' holds. requirements.txt:23,50 locks anthropic==2.8.0 and httpx2==2.16.0. NOT settled: that the tests pass, i.e. that anthropic 2.8.0's client accepts an httpx2.AsyncClient and the 2.x stream/create path yields these results. No dependency_sources were supplied and I did not run `pytest tests/unit/test_opus_history.py`, so the runtime outcome is unverified.

  </details>

acceptance_criteria:
- [ ] `pyproject.toml` declares the anthropic dependency as `anthropic>=2.8,<3`, and its `dev` extras declare `httpx2`.
- [ ] `requirements.txt` pins anthropic to a 2.x release at or above 2.8, and sqlglot stays at its locked 30.31.0 (the header's regeneration command carries no sqlglot constraint, which commit ec3c67f removed after #372). `pytest -q tests/unit/test_lockfile_guard.py` passes, which asserts that each runtime dependency in `pyproject.toml` is pinned in `requirements.txt` at a version inside its declared range.
- [ ] `test_real_sdk_stream_retains_signature_and_tool_input` and `test_real_sdk_create_retains_signature_and_tool_input` in `tests/unit/test_opus_history.py` run the locked 2.x SDK against a mock HTTP transport and pass. Their assertions on `provider_content`, `content`, `finish_reason`, `usage` and tool calls are unchanged.
- [ ] With `[llm] effort = "high"`, the HTTP request body that the locked 2.x SDK sends from both `send_request` and `stream_request` contains `"output_config": {"effort": "high"}` and no `temperature` key. A test asserts this on the body the mock transport captures, not on a stubbed `messages` object.
- [ ] `sqllens validate -c <path>` exits with code 2 and prints a message that names `temperature` and tells the operator to remove it, for each of these inputs, at minimum: TOML `temperature = 0.2`, TOML `temperature = 0.0`, TOML `temperature = 3`, TOML `temperature = "low"`, and `SQLLENS_LLM__TEMPERATURE=0.2` with no TOML key. `sqllens serve` with the TOML `temperature = 0.2` config exits with code 2 before it starts a server. With `temperature` unset, `sqllens validate` prints `Config OK` and exits 0.
- [ ] `LlmRequest` and `AgentConfig` declare no `temperature` field, `LLMAsJudgeEvaluator.__init__` has no `temperature` parameter, and no payload `AnthropicLlmService._build_payload` returns contains a `temperature` key.
- [ ] `probe_llm` still raises `PreflightError` with subsystem `"llm"` when building `AnthropicLlmService` raises an `anthropic.AnthropicError`, and `probe_llm` with a configured API key returns without error when it builds the real 2.x client.
- [ ] `git grep -n -e 'anthropic>=0.49'` returns no line, so no comment or doc still gives the old 0.49 floor as a reason.
- [ ] `docs/external/configuration.md`'s `[llm]` table states that `temperature` is no longer accepted and that a config that sets it fails to load. `docs/internal/agent/factory.md` states that `temperature` is rejected at config load and that no request carries it. The config template that `sqllens init` writes has no `temperature` line.
- [ ] A `changelog.d/<PR>.<category>.md` fragment for this change states each of these: SQL Lens now requires the anthropic 2.x SDK; `[llm] temperature`, added earlier in this unreleased cycle, is no longer accepted and a config that sets it fails to load; the 2.x SDK sends the API key as `Authorization: Bearer`; SQL Lens has no setting to send the key as `X-Api-Key`; and a gateway behind `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` that reads only `X-Api-Key` should be changed to read the `Authorization` header.
- [ ] The change adds no SQL Lens setting for the API key header or for extra request headers, so with a configured API key SQL Lens leaves the 2.x SDK's `Authorization: Bearer <key>` header in place.
- [ ] The change leaves `changelog.d/+legacy-004.added.md` unchanged, so the next release's notes still list `llm.temperature` as added, next to this change's fragment saying it is no longer accepted.
